description: T-Route is NOAA Office of Water Prediction's channel-routing model for vector river networks. It contains Python network preparation and Fortran routing engines, including Muskingum-Cunge and diffusive-wave calculations, with reservoir and data-assimilation modules. Inputs are connected channels and lateral inflow series; outputs are routed streamflows. Geographic extent and temporal resolution follow the network, forcing and configuration, with a Lower Colorado River demonstration included. Apache-2.0 source is free through GitHub. A limitation is that core workflows remain tailored to the National Water Model while generalisation continues. The BMI interface supports HY_Features, whereas the command-line interface also supports NHD networks. T-Route can supply river conditions for flood-defence and water-system simulations. TELEMAC-MASCARET (model-telemac-mascaret) provides related hydraulic modelling. Documentation and example commands were inspected, but neither the routing code nor its demonstration data was downloaded.
